title.narrative: Enhance provision of integrated critical services to vulnerable people in underserved locations in Rural Damascus

description.narrative: ltpgtThis project aims at supporting 6 under-served locations in Rural Damascus with integrated services under food, health and protection sectors.ltbrgtServices will be implemented in a complementarity approach that includes providing integrated services to beneficiaries in the targeted locations, this will be done as the following:ltbrgtIn Ain elfigeh, and Madaya services will be provided through integrated mobile team that will provide health and protection services, in addition to provision of food baskets according to specific criteria that was set according to community consultation and a cross cutting data will be done to prevent duplication with other actors. ltbrgtHealth services will include provision of medical consultation in fields of pediatrics and internal medicine and will be linked with Child protection and food activities to prioritize PwD and people with chronic disease and malnutrition to benefit from food baskets. In ein elfigeh, project is aiming at continue food basket distribution after the current distribution is made under SHF project that will end by January 2025. ltbrgtIn Duma, where Altamayoz has a fixed center, activities will include supporting GBV prevention services as a complimentary service to the already existing CP and MA activities implemented, in addition, health services will include the provision of Internal medicine consultations to meet the needs in this field to complement the alraedy existing Pediatrics and gynecology consultations provided at Duma center.ltbrgtIn Babela, activities will be through providing health activities in Altamayoz centers as a complement to education and CP services that will support children through an integrated approach to help improve their health, protection and education situation, in addition to provide GP activities and provide families with food basket to lower the burden on parents and increase food security rate and minimize drop out of school rate.ltbrgtIn Arbin, Health, Food, GBV, GP, CP and MA package of services will be provided in Arbin center to support the basic needs of people and enhance supporting lifesaving services.ltbrgtIn Maliha, activities will include continuation of Food and health services current provided under SHF, and adding Protection activities to support an integrated lifesaving services.ltbrgtConsultations have been made with sectors coordinators prior the submission of the project to assure coordination and guidance, and targeted locations have been fully discussed with sector coordinator especially FASltbrgtlt/pgt
